name: What are my options if a repair is not feasible after the consultation?

mainEntity.name: What are my options if a repair is not feasible after the consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: If a repair is not feasible, the consultation will shift towards discussing full roof replacement options. Our specialists will outline material choices, project timelines, and financing options for a new roof installation. This ensures you have a clear understanding of the next steps and available solutions to protect your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: If repair isn't feasible, the consultation will cover full roof replacement options, including materials, timelines, and financing.
